# Change context — patch_settings explicit-value fix (standalone)

## Intent and authority
- User request (explicit): "update patch_settings: omitted keys keep their current values; explicitly
  supplied values, including None, empty text and False, replace the current value. Preserve
  caller-owned inputs and existing exports. Add no dependencies."
- README.md (repo root, explicit): Python 3.9+, standard library only; test command
  `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests`; HTTP patch handler (api.py) and CLI note action (cli.py)
  share settings.patch_settings; callers own their input dictionaries; a patch contains only
  explicitly supplied keys; note accepts text or None; enabled is boolean.

## Change boundary
- Selector: unstaged worktree changes on branch `master`, HEAD 0b902ff ("Initial subject").
- Changed files (author-reported; `git status`/`git diff` could not run — Bash permission denied):
  - settings.py (modified)
  - tests/test_settings.py (modified; 5 tests added)
- Unchanged consumers: api.py (update_preferences), cli.py (clear_note), README.md.

## Baseline (review base) — author-captured, NOT a git blob
The pre-edit settings.py content below was returned by a Read tool call of the worktree file at
HEAD 0b902ff with a clean status, before any edit in this session. No blob hash available
(git unavailable). Full file, lines 1-5, nothing omitted:

```python
def patch_settings(current, patch):
    result = dict(current)
    for key, value in patch.items():
        result[key] = value or current.get(key)
    return result
```

Pre-edit tests/test_settings.py contained only `test_updates_note` (lines 1-10 of the current file's
first test, identical text; imports were only `unittest` and `from api import update_preferences`).

## Existing behavior / defect
`value or current.get(key)` discards falsey explicit values (None, "", False), so cli.clear_note
could not clear a note and api.update_preferences could not disable `enabled` or set an empty note.

## Delivery constraints
No dependencies; stdlib only; Python 3.9+. No deployment/migration/flags involved (in-process helper).

## Scenarios and evidence (author-attributed)
- Explicit None / "" / False replace current; omitted keys preserved; current and patch not mutated;
  update_preferences filters to note/enabled; clear_note sets None.
- Tests added for these in tests/test_settings.py. Tests have NOT been executed: Bash is denied in
  this session. No runtime results exist.

## Rejected approaches
None.

No task scope available — review the diff on its own merits without assuming any feature-level design doc.
